title: (RHEA-2013:1191)  new package: redhat-access-plugin-openstack
portal_summary: A new redhat-access-plugin-openstack package is now available.
portal_product_filter: Red Hat OpenStack Platform|Red Hat OpenStack|grizzly|x86_64
portal_solution:
Before applying this update, make sure all previously released errata
relevant to your system have been applied.  Then while logged in as the root
user type 'yum install -y redhat-access-plugin-openstack'.

Once installation is complete refresh your browser's connection to the Red Hat
OpenStack administration console.  The plug-in will then be visible.   

This update is available via the Red Hat Network.
portal_description:
The Red Hat Support plug-in for Red Hat OpenStack is a Technology Preview
feature which offers seamless integrated access to Red Hat subscription services
from the Red Hat OpenStack administration portal. The plug-in provides automated
functionality that enables quicker help, answers, and proactive services. It
offers easy and instant access to Red Hat exclusive knowledge, resources,
engagement, and diagnostic features. 

Subscribers that install this plug-in will enjoy the following services from the
Red Hat OpenStack administration portal:
- Conveniently access exclusive Red Hat knowledge and solutions.
- Use 'Red Hat Access: Diagnose' on console logs to find relevant solutions.
- Use 'Red Hat Access: Search' to find in-product information about error codes,
messages, etc.

Detailed information about the Red Hat Support plug-in for Red Hat OpenStack can
be found in the Red Hat Customer Portal at:
https://access.redhat.com/site/articles/470433
